description: Land Acquisition - Jaffna Town ward No. 01 (Fort), Jaffna D/S Division, Jaffna District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically declares that a particular land parcel is needed for public purpose and will be acquired. The content includes detailed land descriptions, boundaries, location information, and extent measurements, which are all characteristic of land-related matters. While it mentions a government minister (Gayantha Karunatilake), this is incidental to the primary purpose of the notice, which is land acquisition. The content does not focus on government structure, personnel changes, or portfolio responsibilities, making it clearly a Land Gazette.
